final_task_tree.title: Figure out a training plan for my dog
final_task_tree.description:
Rescue border collie mix, 14 months. Pulls hard on the leash and barks at every other dog on walks. South Bay, California; I can do evenings and weekends.

Three things only:
1. Whether to hire a trainer or do it myself.
2. If hiring — two or three local options with real prices.
3. A week-by-week plan for the first four weeks.

Don't research anything beyond those three.

subtasks.title: Decide: hire a trainer vs. DIY for leash pulling + dog reactivity
subtasks.description: Produce a clear recommendation for a 14-month rescue border collie mix that pulls hard on leash and barks at every dog on walks. Owner is in South Bay CA, available evenings and weekends. Compare DIY (books/videos/self-directed protocols) against hiring a professional, specifically for reactivity — which is the harder of the two problems. Output: a recommendation with reasoning, plus what the DIY-only path would cost in time and what it risks.

subtasks.title: Find 3 South Bay trainers who handle leash reactivity, with real prices
subtasks.description: Find local, force-free / positive-reinforcement trainers or behavior consultants serving the South Bay (San Jose, Sunnyvale, Santa Clara, Mountain View, Campbell, Los Gatos). Requirements: they must explicitly work with leash reactivity / dog-dog reactivity, offer evening or weekend availability, and have published or confirmable pricing. Record for each: business name, credentials, service format (private in-home, board, class), actual price, what's included, city, phone, website.

subtasks.title: Search South Bay reactive-dog trainers and build a candidate shortlist
subtasks.description: Search for positive-reinforcement / force-free trainers and certified behavior consultants (CPDT-KA, KPA-CTP, CBCC-KA, IAABC) serving San Jose, Sunnyvale, Santa Clara, Mountain View, Campbell, Los Gatos who advertise leash reactivity or dog-dog reactivity work. Goal: 6-8 candidates to then price out.

subtasks.title: Pull actual published prices for the shortlisted trainers
subtasks.description: For each shortlisted trainer, fetch their own site to get real numbers: private session rate, package price and session count, whether an initial consult/assessment is priced separately, reactive-dog class price, travel radius, and evening/weekend availability. Note explicitly where a trainer does not publish pricing so the owner knows they must call.

subtasks.title: Write the week-by-week plan for weeks 1-4
subtasks.description: A concrete four-week plan the owner can start on immediately, structured week by week, covering both loose-leash walking and dog reactivity. Must specify what to do each week, session length and frequency, what gear to use, what success looks like before moving to the next week, and what to do when a walk goes wrong. Should work whether or not a trainer is hired.
